comment: Single source of truth for the portable-runtime allowlist in docs/portability-contract.md: the only SONAMEs a no_sys_deps binary may link, besides the ld-linux-* loaders matched by regex in lib.js. libstdc++/libgfortran/libgomp are deliberately absent — SONAME presence proves nothing about their symbol-version floors (GLIBCXX_ etc.), so they count as system dependencies.
